name: claude-eng-team
description: A full engineering team for Claude Code: 17 role agents, enforced approvals, TDD, ADRs, threat models and a story → dev → prod git flow. One command to install, one to undo.
author: Andres Romo (ROMOLABS)

scripts.test: node --test --require ./test/sandbox.js test/*.test.js && sh -c 'HOME=$(mktemp -d) CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR= && export HOME CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR && python3 -I -B payload/hooks/tests/test_guard_actions.py && python3 -I -B payload/hooks/tests/test_codex_fallback.py && python3 -I -B test/interactive_test.py'
